---
title: "HOBO Logger Temperature Data"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r load}
df <- read.csv("HONS_GKHE_hobo_logger_data.csv")
df$date_time <- as.POSIXct(df$date_time, format = "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S")
```

## Temperature over time

All three treatments plotted together.

```{r temp-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
ggplot(df, aes(x = date_time, y = temperature_celsius, colour = treatment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Temperature (°C)", colour = "Treatment") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Temperature by treatment (faceted)

```{r temp-facet, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
ggplot(df, aes(x = date_time, y = temperature_celsius, colour = treatment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~treatment, ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Temperature (°C)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Light over time

```{r light-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
ggplot(df, aes(x = date_time, y = light_lux, colour = treatment)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Light (lux)", colour = "Treatment") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Summary statistics

```{r summary}
df %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_temp = round(mean(temperature_celsius, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd_temp   = round(sd(temperature_celsius, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    min_temp  = round(min(temperature_celsius, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    max_temp  = round(max(temperature_celsius, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Treatment", "N", "Mean °C", "SD", "Min °C", "Max °C"))
```
